The P1 source branch is inactive in Flat, whose painter path remains unchanged. These are distinct observations. Independent admission must decide whether supplemental same-scene raw capture is necessary before timing execution; no criterion is waived.

Independent admission must decide whether supplemental same-scene raw capture is necessary before timing execution; no criterion is waived.
Only total-duration samples are emitted. Paint and flush/present summaries are supplied by the unchanged executable and cannot be independently recomputed from unavailable component samples.

Scene/state checks combine fixed source, unchanged arguments, emitted metadata and the native assertions. The benchmark has a layout fingerprint and scenario name, not a complete serialized state witness.

One shared-host batch gives descriptive comparisons only: no causal attribution, confidence, equivalence, display-smoothness, audio/hardware deadline, full-domain performance or whole-interface 1:1 conclusion.
CPU affinity does not reserve a core or establish shared-host isolation. Root must reserve a quiet interval and record external workload knowledge.

No pooled cases, sample trimming, replacement process, retry, adaptive order or rerun-to-pass is allowed. Any further batch needs its own prospectively reviewed reason and protocol; all original outcomes remain retained.
Preflight references current compile/dependency databases and retained receipts. It does not retrospectively observe original compiler execution.
